digest.component_or_area: LLM gate verdicts and signed payload schema
propositions: Signed gate verdicts currently record only a model string and cannot distinguish between first-class and best-effort provider tiers or between direct and gateway-backed endpoint origins.

A new additive-only provider_provenance object must be stamped into verdicts, carrying provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, and effective capabilities, enabling consumers to reject off-tier verdicts.

The endpoint_host field must extract only the hostname via urlparse().hostname to exclude embedded credentials, with a security oracle test asserting no credential material appears in persisted payloads.

The provenance record must be assembled once in runner.py from already-resolved data (provider, model, base_url, capabilities) and passed through gate assembly paths without recomputation to avoid divergence.
Legacy payloads lacking provider_provenance must remain loadable with valid signatures, establishing backward compatibility for the optional new field.

The implementation requires wiring provenance through finalize_verdict call sites in plan-review, code-review, and completion gates, plus documentation and contract-level tests on persisted payload shape.
